user.title: Set up your Wall Panel
user.description: Double press: next entity. Hold: selection menu, except on media pages where hold plays/pauses and press toggles mute. In the menu, rotate to highlight, press to select, hold to cancel. Buttons, relays, audio and displays belong to this integration; MQTT is the local transport.

data_description.entities: Choose Climate, Light, Cover and Media Player entities. Media: rotate volume, press mute, hold play/pause, double press next page. The panel Audio entity uses direct local control with HA feedback; other players use HA. Time, date and weather appear on the idle screensaver.

button.title: Button {button} assignments
button.description: Assign single and double press independently. For scenes or other HA actions, select Run Home Assistant actions and use the action editor below. Local relay assignments are saved on the panel and work without HA/Wi-Fi; configuring one does not switch the relay. All four buttons work on the first press with the main display off and do not wake it. Single press waits 400 ms to distinguish double press. These buttons do not provide a reliable long-press signal.

data.double_press_actions: Double press HA actions (used only in Run HA actions mode)

order.title: Arrange the knob menu

dashboard.title: Dashboard URL
dashboard.description: Save the dashboard URL for the Wall Panel app. The app hardware service must be running for delivery. Dashboard delivery is currently under review. The Dashboard URL entity shows panel confirmation.

screensaver.title: Knob screensaver
screensaver.description: After 15 seconds without knob input, show time, date and weather. Using the knob returns to its controls immediately. The LED is red while idle and white during use. Enable Knob activity mode for automatic switching. Turning the screensaver off restores the 15-second LCD-off behavior. Weather is optional; without it, the clock and date still work.

group_network.title: Panel audio groups connection
group_network.description: Enter any panel running the new group manager. HA mirrors its LAN room directory; playback and saved groups remain on panels. Use the API token configured in that panel Audio Receiver settings, if any.

audio_groups.title: Saved audio groups
audio_groups.description: Create or edit a panel-owned group, recall it, or delete it. Saving a group does not start music. Choose each source panel audio file in the panel app first.
